digitalise.title: Your wardrobe, in your pocket
digitalise.body: Photograph your clothes, shoes and accessories and add the details that matter: category, colours, season, brand, price.

plan.title: Create & plan outfits
plan.body: Compose looks from your own pieces, get ideas based on simple rules, plan the week ahead and pack smarter for trips.

value.title: Wear more of what you own
value.body: See what you really wear, rediscover forgotten pieces, keep track of laundry and shopping, and set gentle goals.

onboarding.currencyHint: Used for prices and your budget. You can change it later in Settings.

planned_outfit.title: Planned outfit

data.title: Backup & data
data.storageNote: Your wardrobe and photos are stored only on this device. Photos are compressed when added. Android cloud auto-backup is turned off, so keep your own backup file somewhere safe.
data.exportMessage: Create a backup file you can save to your drive or send to yourself. You choose where it goes.
data.includePhotosHint: Makes the file much larger (several MB per 100 photos).
data.exportPremium: Backup and CSV exports are part of Premium. Restoring a backup stays free for everyone.
data.shareUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
data.restoreMessage: Restore a ClosetWise backup file. It replaces everything currently in the app.
data.restoreConfirmMessage: Everything in ClosetWise will be replaced by the content of the backup file. This can't be undone.
data.restoreMissing_one: {{count}} photo wasn't in the backup: that item shows a placeholder.
data.restoreMissing_other: {{count}} photos weren't in the backup: those items show a placeholder.

restoreErrors.wrongApp: This file isn't a ClosetWise backup.
restoreErrors.newerSchema: This backup was made with a newer version of ClosetWise. Update the app and try again.
restoreErrors.invalid: This file isn't a valid backup. Your current data was not changed.

data.wipeHint: Deletes every item, photo, outfit, plan, trip, purchase and goal from this device and resets the app.
data.wipeMessage: Your whole wardrobe, photos and history will be removed from this device. Consider exporting a backup first.
data.wipeFinalMessage: This can't be undone. A Premium subscription is not cancelled: manage it in Google Play.

account.title: No account
account.body: ClosetWise has no sign-up and no backend. Nobody but you can see your wardrobe.

local.title: Stored on your device
local.body: Items, outfits, plans, purchases and photos are kept only on this phone. Photos are compressed when added.

transfer.title: No automatic transfer
transfer.body: Nothing is uploaded. A backup file is only created when you export one, and you choose where it goes.

permissions.title: Minimal permissions
permissions.body: The camera is used only when you take a photo. Choosing from the gallery uses the Android photo picker and needs no storage permission.

notifications.title: Optional notifications
notifications.body: Reminders are local, opt-in and generic: they never show photos, item names, destinations or amounts.

ads.title: Ads
ads.body: The free version shows a few banner ads (Google AdMob) on browsing screens, never while you create or plan. Consent is collected with Google's consent tool where required, development builds use test ads, and Premium removes ads.

analytics.title: Anonymous statistics
analytics.body: Only if you agree in Settings: anonymous counts of feature use, never your content.

control.title: You're in control
control.body: Export, restore or delete all your data at any time from Backup & data.
